textReplacements.My research interests are <strong>Virtua: My research interests are virtual reality (VR) and high-performance computer graphics.
textReplacements.The relative topics are: <strong>Foveate: My current interests include foveated rendering; visual perception of colour, depth and texture; stereo reprojection; and image inpainting for disocclusion holes. I use the Vulkan and OpenXR APIs to build rendering and VR experiments.
textReplacements.Develop game server by using C# .NET: Developed game servers using C# and .NET.
textReplacements.Learn C#, Win32, Multi-threading, Unix/L: Gained experience with C#, Win32, multithreading and Unix/Linux systems.
textReplacements.I previously obtained my Master of Scien: Before starting my PhD, I completed an MSc in High-Performance Graphics and Games Engineering at the University of Leeds with Distinction. My MSc covered modelling and rendering, animation and simulation, geometry processing, high-performance graphics, and scientific computation. I also have professional experience as a game server development engineer in Shanghai, working with C#, multithreading, network communication, and performance optimisation.
